name: Ducati Sport Classic / GT1000 / Paul Smart
engine: 992 cc air-cooled two-valve desmo V-twin, fuel injected
intro: Ducati's retro range on the DS1000 engine. Fuel injected, air cooled and belt-driven cams.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.
